about.label: Twist Bioscience
about.summary: Public biotechnology company based in South San Francisco that manufactures synthetic DNA and DNA products for customers in a wide range of industries.
about.summary_cs: Americká biotechnologická firma, která vyrábí syntetickou DNA pro výzkum a průmysl.

about.label: 10X Genomics
about.summary: American biotechnology company that designs and manufactures sequencing technologies for use in scientific research, with a focus on product development for single-cell and spatial omics.
about.summary_cs: Americká biotechnologická firma, která vyvíjí a vyrábí sekvenační technologie pro vědecký výzkum, zaměřené hlavně na analýzu jednotlivých buněk a prostorovou analýzu tkání.

about.label: UMB Financial Corporation
about.summary: American financial services company headquartered in Kansas City, Missouri.
about.summary_cs: Americká banka a finanční firma se sídlem v Kansas City.

about.label: Viasat
about.summary: American satellite communications company headquartered in Carlsbad, California. The company provides satellite broadband and narrowband connectivity and communications equipment for commercial aviation, maritime, enterprise, consumer, military and government customers.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje satelity a nabízí satelitní internet a komunikaci pro letadla, lodě a armádu.

about.label: InterDigital
about.summary: American technology research and development company that provides wireless and video technologies for mobile devices, networks, and services worldwide.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyvíjí bezdrátové a video technologie a licencuje své patenty výrobcům mobilů a televizí.

about.label: Old National Bank
about.summary: American regional bank with nearly 200 retail branches operated by Old National Bancorp and based in Chicago and Evansville, Indiana.
about.summary_cs: Americká regionální banka se sídlem v Chicagu a v Evansville ve státě Indiana.

about.label: Cytokinetics
about.summary: Biopharmaceutical company based in South San Francisco, California, that develops muscle activators and muscle inhibitors as potential treatments for people with diseases characterized by impaired or declining muscle function.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky na onemocnění se slábnoucí funkcí svalů.

about.label: FirstCash
about.summary: American pawnshop company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas which operates retail pawn stores in the U.S. and Latin America.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec zastaváren v USA a Latinské Americe.

about.label: SM Energy
about.summary: Company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in Denver, Colorado.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která těží ropu a zemní plyn.

about.label: Ryman Hospitality Properties
about.summary: Hotel, resort, entertainment, and media company named for one of its assets: the Ryman Auditorium, a National Historic Landmark in Nashville, Tennessee. This purchase resulted in the ownership of the Grand Ole Opry and associated businesses, including the company's flagship resort property, then known as Opryland Hotel.
about.summary_cs: Americký realitní fond (REIT), který vlastní velké kongresové hotely a zábavní podniky v Nashvillu, včetně Grand Ole Opry.

about.label: PBF Energy
about.summary: Petroleum refining and logistics company that produces and sells transportation fuels, heating oils, lubricants, petrochemical feedstocks, and other petroleum products.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která rafinuje ropu a prodává paliva, topné oleje a maziva.

about.label: StoneX
about.summary: American financial services company. The company operates in six areas: commercial hedging, global payments, securities, physical commodities, foreign exchange and clearing and execution services.
about.summary_cs: Americká finanční firma, která nabízí zajištění proti cenovým výkyvům komodit, obchodování s cennými papíry a devizami a mezinárodní platby.

about.label: Matson, Inc.
about.summary: American ocean transportation and logistics company headquartered in Honolulu, Hawaii. Founded in 1882, Matson, Inc.'s subsidiary Matson Navigation Company provides ocean shipping services across the Pacific to Hawaii, Alaska, Guam, Micronesia, the Pacific islands, China, and Japan.
about.summary_cs: Americká lodní a logistická firma z Honolulu, která přepravuje zboží na Havaj, Aljašku a Guam a z Číny do USA.

about.label: Alkermes
about.summary: Fully-integrated biopharmaceutical company that focuses on developing medicines for psychiatric and neurological disorders.
about.summary_cs: Biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky na psychiatrická a neurologická onemocnění.

about.label: Qualys
about.summary: American technology firm based in Foster City, California, specializing in cloud security, compliance and related services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává cloudové nástroje pro kybernetickou bezpečnost a dodržování předpisů.
